name: Local node, sync and retrieval
purpose: each member's machine holds a verified, encrypted replica of exactly their scopes and answers questions from it, offline if needed.
exit_gate: tampered replica detected and repaired; revoked scope deleted and keys stop; retrieval eval at its threshold (recall@10 0.90).
traps: do not use SurrealDB's on-disk full-text or vector indexes; they would store plaintext.
note: `passes` is set only by CI after a task's acceptance tests pass there. Dependencies default to the previous task in the phase; loosen them when tasks are independent. Areas are a first guess; one agent per area at a time.

tasks.title: Session in the keychain, one WebSocket to the gateway, reconnect with backoff.
spec_refs: README: Desktop app and local node, Sync engine, Data model (Client: SurrealDB embedded replica), Security model (Replicas and sync), Company brain (Retrieval pipeline). Section 11.5 and 11.8.
acceptance: a tampered replica is detected and repaired; a revoked scope is deleted and its key stops; disk dump of the replica shows no plaintext content (grep the files for known statements); offline ask works from the replica; retrieval eval at threshold.
